remarks: Spacious and Stylish 1BR/1BA + Office in Prime Walk-to-Train Location! Step into this beautifully updated home featuring freshly painted interiors and newly refinished hardwood floors. The open kitchen, complete with a peninsula, is perfect for entertaining and flows seamlessly into the oversized living room, which boasts sliders leading to a generous balcony-ideal for relaxing or enjoying morning coffee. The bedroom comfortably fits a king-size bed and includes a large walk-in closet. The bathroom offers a double vanity and a convenient tub/shower combo. Additional features include two designated parking spaces, a full-size washer/dryer in the unit, and an unbeatable location. Enjoy the vibrant downtown Stamford lifestyle with its diverse restaurants, shops, and entertainment options, or hop on the train for an easy commute to NYC. Nestled along a charming tree-lined street, this unit truly has it all! Ready for immediate occupancy-don't miss out!
